description: This file is the code-behind for the 'TheorySet.aspx' page in an online examination system. It contains event handlers for page load, button clicks, and dropdown selections, managing course and question set data, and performing database operations for adding questions and exams.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class for managing the theory question setup page, including course selection, question addition, and exam setup within the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, currently with no active code.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new theory question to the database, assigns question number, and alerts the user.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets exam details in the database for the selected course and transfers to the admin panel.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course dropdown when the semester selection changes.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on the selected course.
